question: Who founded the independent State of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Murshid Quli Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **The founder of the Independent State of Bengal was Murshid Quli Khan, who served as the governor of Bengal under the Mughal Empire from 1717 to 1727.**
 
• He managed to consolidate his power in the region and established an independent state with its capital at **Murshidabad.**
 
• Murshid Quli Khan was known for his **administrative and economic reforms, **which included introducing a new revenue system and promoting trade and commerce.
 
• His successors, including **Alivardi Khan and Siraj-ud-Daulah**, continued to rule the independent State of Bengal until it was annexed by the British East India Company in the mid-18th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alivardi Khan was the Nawab of Bengal from 1740 to 1756.**

 
 
• He was known for his military campaigns against the **Marathas and the Britis**h.
 
 
 
• **Sarafraz Khan was a governor of Bengal under the Mughal Empire in the early 18th century.**
 
 
• Sarfaraz Khan was **Murshid Khan's nominee** to succeed him as there was no direct successor.
 
 
 
• Shuja-ud-Din was a governor of Bengal under the Mughal Empire in the mid-18th century.
 
 
• He was** deposed by the British** before he could establish an independent state.
